annotations.title: 2026 Capital Gains Tax and QSBS Calculator

description: Computes 2026 IRS short-term and long-term federal capital gains tax brackets stacked over ordinary income, 3.8% NIIT surcharge, state capital gains tax, and Section 1202 QSBS exclusions. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/capital-gains-and-qsbs-tax-calculator.

filing_status.description: IRS filing status (single or mfj). Default single.

hold_years.description: Asset holding period in years (>1 yr qualifies for LTCG). Default 3.

qsbs_regime.description: Startup QSBS Section 1202 regime. Default none.

state_tax_pct.description: State capital gains tax rate percent. Default 5.
